pick.name: Microsoft Marketplace (transactable SaaS)
pick.what: List SaaS/professional services so enterprises buy against their Microsoft agreement
pick.why: Flat 3% store fee; Microsoft bills and collects; no India-buyers-only restriction found (unlike AWS); also hosts a healthcare channel (Dragon Copilot physician apps)
pick.free_limits: No listing cost; 3% of transactions (50% off on private-offer renewals)

alts.name: AWS Marketplace (India seller track)
alts.what: Largest cloud marketplace; India-based sellers supported since Nov 2025
alts.why: Pick for Indian enterprise buyers, or for global buyers once you have a non-India entity
alts.free_limits: Standard listing fees (+18% GST) in INR; needs GSTIN with e-invoicing, India bank, standalone AWS account

alts.name: Google Cloud Marketplace
alts.why: Requires Partner Network membership, hosting primarily on Google Cloud and generating GCP consumption, which rules it out for a Cloudflare-hosted stack

candidates.name: Microsoft Marketplace
candidates.verdict: PICK when a buyer asks to procure through a marketplace

candidates.name: AWS Marketplace
candidates.verdict: India sellers can sell only to India buyers; global needs a non-India entity

candidates.name: Google Cloud Marketplace
candidates.verdict: Only if you host on GCP

decision: Defer all marketplaces until an enterprise buyer asks. Microsoft's 3% transact model is then the best fit; SaaS offers need multitenancy, sign-in with both Microsoft Accounts and Entra ID SSO, a landing page + webhook and the SaaS Fulfillment APIs (Claude Code can build these). Publisher enrolment asks for a company legal name and signing authority, so confirm a proprietorship qualifies before building. AWS's India track sells only to Indian buyers, so a global AWS listing needs the US entity.
details: Microsoft payout/tax-profile support for India-registered publishers not confirmed (US-sales withholding default 30% without treaty forms, per Microsoft help); verify.

verify.note: Confirmed: 3% store fee, 50% off for private-offer renewals, doc updated 2026-08-18, Dragon Copilot offer type. Two corrections. Transactable SaaS must support BOTH Microsoft Accounts (MSA) and Entra ID SSO, not just Entra ID. Publisher enrolment needs a company legal business name and authority to sign for the company, so a sole proprietor's eligibility is unconfirmed (likely needs the Udyam/GST business identity). Microsoft's tax page lists India as a 'Reseller' country for commercial buyers but says nothing about India-based publishers. AWS alt confirmed verbatim (India sellers sell only to India buyers, USD public pricing, INR payout, GSTIN with e-invoicing, standalone account).
